name: image-portrait-collage
title: Portrait Collage
description: Scattered print collage of one sitting, polaroid style

subject.descent: Not asserted — synthetic subject; specify explicitly when recreating.
subject.physical: One sitter repeated across many small prints — long dark hair, varied head angles
subject.expression: Range from neutral to softly smiling

composition.placement: Overlapping prints across the full frame

framing.subjectScale: Scattered prints cover ~92% of the frame; largest print ~30% of frame width
framing.subjectBox: Dominant print x≈32–68%, y≈28–72%; smaller prints tile the surround
framing.anchors: Central print eyeline at ~45% of frame height
framing.edges: Outer prints crop at all four frame edges
framing.negativeSpace: Small pale gaps between prints; no clean outer margin

environment.setting: Studio, restaged as a physical layout
environment.background: Pale surface beneath the scattered prints

camera.quality: Clean, with print edges and slight paper drop-shadow

atmosphere.story: A sitting laid out on a table to choose from.
